## File: facebookresearch_sam2/training/scripts/sav_frame_extraction_submitit.py

Prompts

```
['run the SA-V frame extraction script to extract JPEG frames from MP4 videos using submitit on SLURM', 'run the decode_video function to read all frames from an MP4 file using OpenCV VideoCapture', 'run the extract_frames function to sub-sample video frames at a given sample rate', 'run the submitit_launch function to extract and save JPEG frames for a list of video paths', 'run the get_args_parser function to build an argparse parser for SA-V frame extraction CLI arguments']
```

```
{'run_frame_extraction': 'run the SA-V frame extraction script to extract JPEG frames from MP4 videos using submitit on SLURM', 'run_decode_video': 'run the decode_video function to read all frames from an MP4 file using OpenCV VideoCapture', 'run_extract_frames': 'run the extract_frames function to sub-sample video frames at a given sample rate', 'run_submitit_launch': 'run the submitit_launch function to extract and save JPEG frames for a list of video paths', 'run_get_args_parser': 'run the get_args_parser function to build an argparse parser for SA-V frame extraction CLI arguments'}
```
